title: Stabiliser Box Upper Panel — Detailed Inspection at the Rib 6 Splice
abstract: Detailed inspection of the stabiliser box upper panel at the rib 6 splice, covering the splice plate and both fastener rows by eddy current from the upper panel access provisions.

sections.purpose: This task gives the detailed inspection of the upper panel at the rib 6 splice, at the scheduled interval and after any reported overload event on the empennage.
sections.job_setup_note: The inspection is done through the upper panel access provisions with the stabiliser installed. Get the eddy current set with the splice probe and the calibration block for the panel thickness. Allow for the access platform booking; the empennage platform is usually shared with the fin work.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the upper panel access provisions and put the access platform in position. 2. WARNING: DO NOT STAND ON THE STABILISER SURFACE OUTSIDE THE MARKED WALKWAY. THE PANEL IS NOT A WALKING SURFACE. 3. Clean the splice area and remove any loose sealant. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of the splice plate and the adjacent fastener rows. 5. Calibrate the eddy current set on the block for the panel thickness at the splice. 6. Do the eddy current inspection along both fastener rows of the splice plate. 7. Record any indication with its position, length and amplitude. 8. Compare each indication against the acceptance in SRM-M-55-10-11-003. 9. Re-apply the sealant that was removed. 10. Close the access provisions.
sections.close_out: Make sure no tool or debris remains inside the box. Confirm the access provisions are secure and the sealant is continuous. Record the inspection, the standard inspected against and any indication in the aircraft structural repair record and in the technical log.

safety_precautions: Do not stand on the stabiliser surface outside the marked walkway.
Use the access platform rated for the empennage.

tooling.description: Eddy current set with splice probe

issue.reason: Extended eddy current coverage and the acceptance caution for the modified standard issued, ahead of the first shop embodiment.

abstract: Detailed inspection of the stabiliser box upper panel at the rib 6 splice, with the eddy current coverage and the acceptance that differ between the delivered and the extended stiffener standards.

sections.purpose: This task gives the detailed inspection of the upper panel at the rib 6 splice, at the scheduled interval and after any reported overload event on the empennage.
sections.job_setup_note: The inspection is done through the upper panel access provisions with the stabiliser installed. Confirm which stiffener standard the aircraft carries before you start: the eddy current coverage on the extended standard runs two bays further outboard, and the acceptance limits at the splice are narrower. Get the eddy current set with the splice probe and the calibration block for the panel thickness.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the upper panel access provisions and put the access platform in position. 2. WARNING: DO NOT STAND ON THE STABILISER SURFACE OUTSIDE THE MARKED WALKWAY. THE PANEL IS NOT A WALKING SURFACE. 3. Clean the splice area and remove any loose sealant. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of the splice plate and the adjacent fastener rows. 5. Calibrate the eddy current set on the block for the panel thickness at the splice. 6. Do the eddy current inspection along both fastener rows of the splice plate. 7. On aircraft post MOD-168104, extend the eddy current coverage outboard to rib 9 along the extended stiffener run. 8. CAUTION: DO NOT USE THE DELIVERED STANDARD ACCEPTANCE AT A SPLICE THAT CARRIES THE THICKER PLATE. THE SIGNAL RESPONSE DIFFERS AND A REJECTABLE INDICATION CAN BE READ AS ACCEPTABLE. 9. Record any indication with its position, length and amplitude. 10. Compare each indication against the acceptance in SRM-M-55-10-11-003. 11. Re-apply the sealant that was removed. 12. Close the access provisions.
sections.close_out: Make sure no tool or debris remains inside the box. Confirm the access provisions are secure and the sealant is continuous. Record the inspection, the standard inspected against and any indication in the aircraft structural repair record and in the technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; step 7 applies to aircraft post MOD-168104 only

Use the access platform rated for the empennage.
